physicalNotes: Radius 0.773 +/- 0.023 solar radii from Naponiello et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5800 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A..79N/abstract): 537,776 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.778 +/- 0.037 solar masses from Naponiello et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5800 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A..79N/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4850 +/- 78 K from Naponiello et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5800 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A..79N/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
